== English errata comparison sources ==
The Decipher Supplement replaces the prohibition on using the gambler’s text with cancellation and makes the payment after a battle is just initiated. Payment still equals the gambler’s ability.

Decipher, [https://wiki.swccg.com/images/f/ff/Decipher_Glossary_Supplement.pdf#page=4 Glossary Supplement], updated 29 January 2002, PDF page 4. Players Committee, Decipher Errata, official text as of 1 January 2013, PDF page 8. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20160809094140id_/http://www.starwarsccg.org/wp/wp-content/uploads/DecipherErrata.pdf#page=8 Internet Archive]. Players Committee, [https://wiki.swccg.com/images/a/a0/PC-Decipher-Errata-June-2017.pdf#page=8 Decipher Errata], official text as of June 2017, PDF page 8. Players Committee, [https://wiki.swccg.com/images/3/3d/SWCCG_2023_AdvancedRulebook.pdf#page=116 2023 Advanced Rulebook], Appendix A, PDF page 116.
